description: A headless companion plugin for math-teacher, same relationship city-weather has to city-layout: watches a folder of real LaMa (CC BY 3.0) worksheet PDFs, parses them into a browsable catalog of ready-to-use questions (metadata only -- titel/Grundkompetenz/Klasse/Quelle/Aufgabenformat -- never the full question content until it's actually filed into a class), and files a chosen subset into a live math-teacher class's own bank through the exact same authoring_command import channel a human-driven import already uses. Not a UI of any kind -- install it alongside math-teacher and drive it from math-teacher's own LaMa upload panel.
author: prackoreal
